Specifically, we prompt GPT-4o to assess whether the generated critique aligns with the human-written critique. We instruct the model to select one of the following options: (1) Error Match: The generated critique identifies the same error as described by the human. (2) Error, No Match: The generated critique discusses a different error than the one noted by the human. (3) No Error Detected, No Match: The generated critique states that there is no error, despite the human indicating otherwise.
methods: Prompt-based pairwise evaluation of critique alignment

TofuEval contains 50 documents for each dataset, each paired with three topics. It also contains sentence-level faithfulness judgments from annotators for summaries generated by five different systems. For each sentence, annotators were asked to provide a binary faithfulness judgment and, if deemed unfaithful, write a critique explaining the error.
